trainingCurveUnit: Loss of one sampled mini-batch at each100th update; NOT full TRAIN mean. Original CE includes all original valid targets; main CE excludes eligible newline numerator but retains original denominator. Missing old contextPreferenceLoss is absent objective, not measured zero.
contextCurveUnit: Pre-update loss and correct/wrong mean target NLL on two deterministic cyclic auxiliary pairs, eval mode with gradients; not an all-pool loss curve or generalization metric.
validationCurve: paired-ce-curve.csv from compare_losses.py: full unchanged DEV at0/every500; weighted3views, no language-success implication
